subject: Update UGP and UFL files before next release

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Update UGP and UFL files before next release
parts:
Hi,

I just want to let you know that we're about to roll out a new version
soon. In the meantime, I recommend you to already now go online and
update whatever UGP and UFL annotation files you are using. The new
versions are dated 2008-02-14 (Feb 14, 2008) or newer. If you don't
know what I am talking about, you most likely don't use them and you
don't have to worry. They have this far mainly been used for
copy-number analysis. The upcoming version of the package will give
an error message letting you know that you use an old file and you
have to download a newer one. So, if you download those files already
today, you will not even notice the transition.

In case, if you have created your own UGP or UFL file, let me know,
and I'll show you how to make them compatible with the upcoming
package version.

Cheers

Henrik
